name: QBF Evaluation
description: QBF Evaluation is a benchmark/competition for solvers tackling quantified Boolean formulas, which extend propositional satisfiability with universal and existential quantifiers. It measures the ability to reason over alternations of quantifiers and to decide satisfiability efficiently under formal constraints.
evaluation_method: Solver accuracy on QBF instances, typically under time limits, with performance aggregated by solved instances, runtime, and competition ranking rules.
notes: Exact scoring and track structure may vary across years; commonly used to compare advances in QBF reasoning and preprocessing.
